items.title: A map of modules over a local ring whose reduction is injective is universally injective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a local criterion for universal injectivity: for a map from a projective module to a flat module over a local ring whose reduction modulo the maximal ideal is injective, the map is universally injective (statement lines 1945-1951, tag 05FX-adjacent). The proof reduces to a finite free source, writes the flat target as a directed colimit of finite free modules and factors the map through one of them, observes that injectivity of the reduction persists so that the map into each late piece is a split injection, and concludes by compatibility of tensoring with colimits. The splitting step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
